# Maruti Techlabs

> Maruti Techlabs is an AI/ML and custom software development company specializing in cloud engineering, DevSecOps, and generative AI solutions for enterprise clients.

Maruti Techlabs serves Fortune 500 companies across healthcare, insurance, and legal sectors with expertise in AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, and modern DevOps practices. The company combines AI/ML capabilities with cloud-native development and security-first engineering approaches.

## Key Topics

- Generative AI & LLM Applications
- DevSecOps & Cloud Security
- AWS & Azure Cloud Services
- Kubernetes & Container Orchestration
- CI/CD Pipeline Automation
- AI/ML Development
- Software Product Engineering
- Cloud Migration & Cost Optimization
- Enterprise Identity & Access Management
- Healthcare Software Solutions
- Insurance Technology
- Digital Transformation
- Microservices Architecture
- Zero-Trust Security
- Data Analytics

## Core Services

- [Generative AI Development Services](https://marutitech.com/services/gen-ai-services): Generative AI services for LLM apps, AI copilots, and enterprise automation solutions.
- [DevSecOps Services](https://marutitech.com/services/devsecops-services): DevSecOps services embedding security with CI/CD, IaC, container and Kubernetes security.
- [DevOps Consulting](https://marutitech.com/services/devops-consulting): DevOps consulting for AWS, GCP, Azure cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and containerization.
- [Cloud Application Development](https://marutitech.com/services/cloud-application-development): Cloud-native development, migration, and consulting for AWS, Azure microservices and serverless.
- [Software Product Engineering](https://marutitech.com/services/software-product-engineering): Software product engineering for SaaS, web, mobile, and low-code/no-code development services.
- [Cloud Consulting Solutions](https://marutitech.com/cloud-consulting-solution): Cloud consulting and audit services for AWS, Azure cost optimization and infrastructure assessment.

## Industry Solutions

- [Healthcare Software Development](https://marutitech.com/healthcare): Healthcare software with telemedicine, AI/ML, cloud solutions for patient care and compliance.
- [Insurance Software Solutions](https://marutitech.com/insurance): Insurance software solutions with AI-powered claims, fraud detection, and compliance standards.
- [Legal Software Development](https://marutitech.com/legal): Legal software solutions with AI tools, OCR, and compliance for legaltech automation.

## Cloud Security & Best Practices

- [Cloud Data Security Best Practices](https://marutitech.com/cloud-data-security-best-practices): Cloud data security best practices addressing 2026 risks, breaches, and multi-cloud compliance.
- [Cloud Security Threats and Best Practices](https://marutitech.com/cloud-security-threats-and-best-practices): Cloud security 2026 outlook on identity controls, zero-trust, and AI/DevOps environment threats.
- [IAM vs PAM for Enterprise Security](https://marutitech.com/iam-vs-pam-for-enterprise-security): Comparison guide on Identity and Privileged Access Management for enterprise cloud security.
- [DevSecOps Tools, Frameworks, and Best Practices](https://marutitech.com/devsecops-tools-best-practices): DevSecOps tools, frameworks, and best practices for secure CI/CD pipeline automation.
